topics.title: Spesolimab (1368-0025 & 1368-0120) GPP – Operational Transfer to LEO Pharma

background.text: BI granted global licensing rights for SPEVIGO® to LEO Pharma effective Oct 1, 2025. Planned start of operational transfer for 1368-0025 OLE study: Q1 2026. 1368-0120 flare retreatment study: DBL for planned interim analysis Aug 29, 2025; completion to final CTR Feb 2027.
background.quote:
1368-0025 OLE study [No updates since last meeting] : Planned start of operational transfer in Q1 2026*
1368-0120 Flare retreatment study [No updates since last meeting] :
DBL for planned interim analysis on 29Aug2025
Completion to final CTR* in Feb 2027

background.text: BI and LEO Pharma to collaborate closely to ensure continuity in ongoing clinical programs for GPP and PG during transition.
background.quote: Boehringer Ingelheim and LEO Pharma will collaborate closely to ensure continuity in the ongoing clinical programs for GPP and PG during the transition period.
